Container.Name: jai-proxy
Container.Overview:
Character Archive: browses, builds and serves SillyTavern V3 character cards. One mount holds everything the container writes -- the archive, galleries, the thumbnail cache, settings.json and server working state.
NOTE: the archive has no authentication and exposes write endpoints. Keep it on the LAN; do not port-forward it.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the archive UI and API. The container always listens on 8000; change only the host side. SillyTavern's stock port is also 8000.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything the container writes: characters/, galleries/, cache/, state/, settings.json. Seed it before first start (docs/DEPLOY.md) and make sure it is owned by the uid in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Bind address
Config.Description: Must stay 0.0.0.0 -- 127.0.0.1 would only be reachable from inside the container.
